text:
sara: Seeing a bunch of customer tickets about delayed pages starting ~11:07 UTC. Inc-bot didn't escalate for some alerts. Investigating now. @micah can you pick?
micah: on it. I can confirm inc-bot webhooks show 502s to notify-proxy around 11:06-11:12 UTC.
kevin: looks like the auth token rotation job renewed signing keys but didn't update the gateway cache. getting 401 from pager-proxy when inc-bot posts.
matt: stack traces from notify-proxy:
```
ERROR auth: token verify failed: kid not found
POST /v1/notify 502
```
micah: rolling a quick cache bump on notify-proxy for eu/na regions, will push now. I’ll also toggle fallback to SMS relay.
inc-bot: automation: alert "high-error-rate" suppressed due to 502 responses from notify-proxy.
jules: CS reporting customers got delayed pages and escalations — one customer opened a support incident complaining of 22m delay. Flagging customer-impact.
kevin: pushed hotfix to rotator: now writes new kid to redis and emits pubsub notification. Redeploying notify-proxy service (rolling pods).
micah: restarted notify-proxy pods in eu-1 (3 pods) @ 11:18 UTC.
sara: confirm inc-bot started sending again?
inc-bot: delivered 12 alerts to oncall at 11:20:43 UTC (post-restart)
matt: can see successful 200s in logs after 11:19:30, sample:
```
INFO notify: forwarded alert id=abcd1234 to oncall
200 POST /v1/notify
```
jules: CS: customers notified and offered incident follow-up. No SLA breach declared yet but we need to assess SLA window and ETA for root cause note.
micah: manual mitigation: enabled SMS fallback for critical severity until rotator fully stabilizes. leaving automation off for next 30m.
kevin: scheduled a follow-up job to reconcile any missed pages by querying alert history and re-firing critical ones.
sara: assigning action items: kevin to write short RCA draft, micah to confirm oncall handoff logs, matt to verify replay script and publish list of re-fired alerts to #support. We'll run a quick postmortem at 14:00 UTC.
matt: replay script output shows 7 critical alerts re-fired to oncall, and 3 customer-facing incidents re-notified.
jules: note for postmortem: include CS impact timeline and which customers were re-notified.
micah: oncall handoff confusion note: during the incident two handoff messages were suppressed because inc-bot treated the notify-proxy 502s as automation failures and didn't post join/ack messages. we should patch inc-bot to always send handoff metadata even when delivery fails.
kevin: agree. adding idempotent metadata publish to rotator so downstream systems can still know new key was issued.
sara: thanks all. I'll tag this for formal postmortem. If anyone finds more gaps DM me.
micah: marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
